entries.40aad73f2af603c6: An envelope manufacturer headquartered in Chuo-ku, Osaka, which forms a group with 4 consolidated subsidiaries. It has two reportable segments, the Package Solutions Business and the Mailing & Digital Solutions Business; consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥21,831 million, and consolidated employees numbered 973. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

entries.4a8213347f1546ae: As its ideal image for 2030, it has formulated the long-term vision IMURA VISION 2030. Its medium-term management plan for fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2026, IMURA VISION 2030 StageⅡ, sets as its basic policy 'Building a solid business foundation by further accelerating transformation and innovation, and aiming to establish a path to sustainable growth and further enhance corporate value.' It is working on expanding sales in strategic markets, expanding sales in packaging materials and product packaging, expanding new services that combine paper and digital, and strengthening sales at overseas subsidiaries.
entries.51b71746ef6237c5: Since its founding in 1950, it has centered on manufacturing and selling envelopes, and it began mailing outsourcing services in 1980, developing them into a second pillar. It now has a group structure that includes packaging materials and businesses for medical institutions, and in an environment where demand for paper media is structurally declining, it is advancing into government demand and packaging fields.

entries.5da1fa3add2df6fe: This business manufactures and sells envelopes used for general office use, shareholder meeting notices, various corporate billing and government notices, including long, square and Western-style envelopes, window envelopes (poly-window and cellophane-window envelopes), postal-insert packaging materials, paper product packaging, and various printed matter, and also operates transport and warehousing. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥15,099 million, making it the largest business. The company manufactures and sells the products, with consolidated subsidiary IMURA Printing Co., Ltd. handling commercial printing and Logitec Co., Ltd. handling transport and storage.
